title: Roses+
description: Adds the old rose back to Minecraft as well as some extras
body: This mod adds not only the rose from pre "The Update that Changed the World" but also some extras such as, the blue rose from pocket edition, a orange rose, a dark blue rose, a pink rose, a purple rose, a green rose, a yellow rose, a diamond rose, an emerald rose, an iron rose, and a golden rose all in one mod!
